question: Which is the most common tidal pattern?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Semi-diurnal tides**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Semi-diurnal tides** are characterized by two high tides and two low tides each day.
 
• This tidal pattern is the most common worldwide, especially along the Atlantic coasts of North America and Europe.
 
• The high and low tides occur approximately every 12 hours and 25 minutes.
 
• Semi-diurnal tides typically have a regular and predictable pattern, making them essential for coastal navigation and marine activities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mixed tides:**

 
 
• Mixed tides have characteristics of both semi-diurnal and diurnal tides.
 
• They usually have two high tides and two low tides of different heights each day.
 
• This pattern is common along the Pacific coasts of North America.
 
 
 
• **Diurnal tides:**
 
 
• Diurnal tides have only one high tide and one low tide each day.
 
• This pattern is less common and can be observed in the Gulf of Mexico and parts of Southeast Asia.
 
 
 
• **Spring tides:**
 
 
• Spring tides are not a tidal pattern but rather a condition where tides have the greatest range between high and low water.
 
• They occur during the full moon and new moon phases when the gravitational forces of the moon and the sun align.
